meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 当你请 Claude 做海报或视觉艺术作品时,它会先写出一份设计理念(.md),再据此刻画成一幅以图形为主、文字极少的 .png/.pdf 作品;坚持原创,不照搬艺术家风格,并可额外打磨润色。
howto.when: 当你要求制作海报、艺术品、设计等静态视觉作品时,该技能就会被触发。

say.text: 请以“数字时代的孤独”为主题设计一张原创海报。
say.note: Claude 会先创建设计理念,再输出成品。

say.text: 用“几何静默”的美学做一个抽象画,输出为 PDF。
say.note: 它会先阐释理念,再生成视觉作品。

say.text: 为我的诗歌集设计一张封面视觉,要走高级艺术路线。
say.note: 它会产出设计理念与打磨过的封面。

howto.what_en: When asked to make a poster or visual art, Claude first writes a design philosophy (.md), then renders it into a mostly visual .png/.pdf piece with minimal text—original, never copying existing artists—and may refine it further.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a poster, piece of art, design, or other static visual work.

say_en.text: Design an original poster on the theme 'Loneliness in the Digital Age'.
say_en.note: Claude writes a design philosophy first, then outputs the work.

say_en.text: Create an abstract artwork in a 'Geometric Silence' aesthetic and export to PDF.
say_en.note: It states the philosophy first, then produces the visual PDF.

say_en.text: Design a cover for my poetry collection with a refined artistic direction.
say_en.note: It produces a design philosophy and a polished cover.
